in_sanskrit.name: Sharvikaariyan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Strength
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharvikaariyan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sharvikaariyan is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sharva' meaning Goddess and 'Kaariyan' meaning the goddess of strength and courage. This name signifies the presence of a strong and courageous woman who embodies the divine feminine energy.
